header.description: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!

quests.title: Quest 1: Battle for the Hill
quests.briefing: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!
primaryGoals: Defeat the Capitol Bosses & Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, Brownsted, Katie Zacharia, Mitch McConnell, and Drunk JD Vance & Kamala Harris).
Storm the Capitol chambers (Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room & Oval Office) and expose the bipartisan slush fund.
Lead all surviving heroes safely to the Capitol Exit Stairs at [14, 2].
